title: [Feature Request] Different carb factors for different times
body: As every diabetic among you knows, the body reacts differently to insulin on different times daily, meaning that one unit of insulin for instance compensates for 7.5 grams of carbs in the morning and for 12.5 grams in the evening. It would be nice if that could be reflected in the calculations (even if I have to enter the factors for every time of the day manually, and the interpolation is only using linear interpolation).
